event_records.description: The parents' group coordinator begins the process of collecting contributions and arranging flowers for the cast.

parents_group_coordinator.name: Parents' group coordinator
parents_group_coordinator.persona_brief:
You are Parents' group coordinator.
The coordinator is responsible for organizing the collection for cast flowers. They have a list of parents who have pledged contributions and need to collect the money, purchase flowers, and arrange handover backstage before curtain. They are aware of the Friday 19:00 deadline.

cast_member_student.name: Cast member (student)
cast_member_student.persona_brief:
You are Cast member (student).
A student in the play who expects flowers from the parents' group. They know the performance starts at 19:00 on Friday and that the parents' group usually organizes flowers.

resolution.question: Opening night of Petersfield Secondary's play is Friday at 19:00. Will the parents' group have collected for the cast flowers and handed them over backstage before curtain?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the parents' group actually handed over flowers to the cast backstage before 19:00 on Friday 2026-11-20. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
